chosenApproach: Package the full 31-chapter 915-verse King James Proverbs corpus (MIT-distributed copy with attribution) directly in a small local TS module. Keep 31 curated bilingual lesson overrides; default to a neutral bilingual reflection question for other verses. Deterministically permute verse slots using stride 433 coprime with 915 and a Dec6 2026 Manila anchor. Exact dates determine verse, no backend writes and no duplicate before cycle completion.
selectionRationale: Previous code selected 31 entries from day-of-month and repeated each calendar month. Full static collection provides offline-first real verse text with zero operational cost and avoids fragile server counters, repeats after short months and accidental Season1 rewards changes.
acceptanceChecks: Exactly 915 authentic numbered KJV verses across 31 chapters and MIT notice bundled offline
First day Dec6 2026 is Proverbs 1:7; 915 distinct date-selected references, then first repeats on day 916
Month, year, leap-day and midnight transitions do not reset selection
Filipino ASD lookup and 31 human-curated takeaways preserved; offline uses accurate KJV, not mismatched text
Show Faith-only and ads/feed isolation remain unchanged; no new server schema, points or reward writes
Source-focused tests, protected feature lock, TypeScript and governance CI green before merge; do not publish OTA
alternativeApproaches: Use random Math.random per user: rejected, users would see inconsistent verses and repeats and restarts could not be audited
Use a remote counter/cron to shuffle 915 verses: rejected, introduces backend cost, data races and offline blank state
Use only 31 verses and roll at month end: rejected by user as too repetitive
Use the entire bundled corpus plus pure deterministic cycle: chosen for zero-cost and weak-network support
